add.k: Robert Farrell's ailing mother, a grocer
st: In season 3, Mrs. Farrell's grocery store is robbed by a gang, and she collapses on seeing her son Robert commit a robbery on TV.

add.k: An athletic classmate who mocks Peter
st: In season 1, Flash taunts Peter in a fake Spider-Man costume, is carried off by a Spider-Slayer, and is hunted again until Spider-Man saves him.
In season 2, Flash tries to impress Debra Whitman, until the Vulture nearly drains his youth and Spider-Man steps in.
In season 4, Flash and Debra are attacked by a creature at a jungle exhibit, and later Miriam drains his plasma.
In season 5, Flash is among the guests at Peter and Mary Jane's wedding when the Green Goblin attacks.
In season 1, Flash watches the news of Asteroid M falling with Peter and Mary Jane.

files.notes: springfieldspringfield has transcripts only for the first five aired episodes of this show, so names and events rest on the Marvel Database episode synopses and appearance lists and the Wikipedia episode list. X-Men '97 step per his Marvel Database page.

add.k: A scientist who works in neogenics
st: In season 3, years earlier, Stillwell irradiates a spider at a science demonstration, and it bites a young Peter Parker.
In season 1, Stillwell's neogenic recombinator turns Mac Gargan into the Scorpion for Jameson, and he tells Gargan it cannot be undone.
In season 2, the Scorpion takes Stillwell from a mental hospital to cure him, but Stillwell blows up his neogenic research instead.

files.notes: springfieldspringfield has transcripts only for the first five aired episodes of this show, so names and events rest on the Marvel Database episode synopses and appearance lists and the Wikipedia episode list. Professor Farley Stillwell in the Sting of the Scorpion synopsis; a line of his is quoted on The Final Nightmare page. The origin step follows the app's Peter Parker file (season 3, Make a Wish); the same scene is also shown in The Insidious Six. He leaves afterwards to avoid neogenics: Active. His lab is never named as an organization: Independent.

add.k: An intelligent lizard who respects humans
st: In season 4, Gila helps kidnap Curt Connors, but refuses to let Spider-Man be destroyed, is locked up with him, and is turned back.

st: In season 5, Gwen tries to stop Spider-Carnage with a sonic gun, is taken hostage by him, and sees him leap into a deadly portal.

No group named on screen: Independent.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Eddie Brock tells Dr. Kafka at Ravencroft how Spider-Man ruined his life, and she believes the symbiote was only a stress illusion. She later helps him reject it, and when Carnage tries to drag her into Dormammu's realm, Eddie as Venom goes through the portal to save her.
stages.whoA: Her patient, who gives himself up to save her
stages.whoB: His Ravencroft therapist, whom he loves

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Cletus Kasady is locked up at Ravencroft next to Eddie Brock and is also Dr. Kafka's patient. As Carnage, he drains her life force, carries her off to Mordo's lair and tries to drag her through Dormammu's portal.
stages.whoA: Carnage, a patient who abducts her
stages.whoB: His Ravencroft therapist, whom he abducts

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Dr. Kafka and Dr. Connors work together to detach Eddie Brock from the symbiote, using what Connors learned of its weakness to sound.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, who helps her free Eddie
stages.whoB: A therapist he helps free Eddie of the symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Dr. Kafka is trying to help Venom reject the symbiote when he spots Spider-Man and attacks him. Later Spider-Man, Venom and Iron Man go to Mordo's lair to rescue her from Carnage.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who helps rescue her
stages.whoB: Eddie's therapist, whom he helps rescue

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Harry Osborn is Dr. Kafka's patient at Ravencroft. He tells her his father was the Green Goblin and Peter is Spider-Man, but she says those images are only his imagination, and soon after he escapes.
stages.whoA: Harry Osborn, her patient at Ravencroft
stages.whoB: His therapist at Ravencroft

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Beyonder chooses Spider-Man for a test of whether good is stronger than evil, and lets Doctor Doom capture him so Spider-Man's team must free him. He then makes Spider-Man leader of the Spider-Men against Spider-Carnage, and his last act saves Spider-Man before he goes home.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, the hero he chooses and tests
stages.whoB: The cosmic being who tests him and makes him leader

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Madame Web brings Spider-Man before the Beyonder, a being from her own universe, and they watch his test together. Before leaving, the Beyonder asks her to tell Spider-Man thank you if he prevails.
stages.whoA: Madame Web, who shares his faith in Spider-Man
stages.whoB: The Beyonder, a being from her universe

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Beyonder picks Doctor Doom as one of the villains of his test and lets Doom capture him. Doom absorbs his power to force eternal peace, until Spider-Man and the heroes defeat Doom and free the Beyonder.
stages.whoA: Doctor Doom, who absorbs his power
stages.whoB: The Beyonder, whose power he absorbs

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robbie Robertson visits his old friend Boris Pushkin at a Moscow police station with Peter. Boris says he knew Peter's parents and gives Robbie the address they need next.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, his old friend
stages.whoB: An old friend in the Moscow police

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Peter visits Boris Pushkin with Robbie in Moscow, looking for the truth about his parents. Boris claims to have known them and gives Robbie an address that helps the search.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, son of people he knew
stages.whoB: A Moscow officer who says he knew his parents

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Police chief Rhienholdt Kragov interrupts Boris's meeting with Robbie and Peter and threatens to arrest them if they do not leave.
stages.whoA: Police chief Kragov, his superior
stages.whoB: A Moscow officer under his command

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Microchip is the Punisher's partner, feeding him crime details and suggesting he capture Spider-Man. He helps the Punisher prepare at their base before the Punisher heads out in his Battle Van.
stages.whoA: The Punisher, the vigilante he works with
stages.whoB: Microchip, his tech partner

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Ned Leeds is a reporter at Jameson's Daily Bugle. He covers Robbie Robertson's conviction and Morbius's return to New York for the paper.
stages.whoA: J. Jonah Jameson, his publisher
stages.whoB: Ned Leeds, one of his reporters

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Ned Leeds works at the Daily Bugle with Robbie Robertson and is assigned stories about Robbie's conviction for crimes he was framed for.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, a Bugle colleague he covers
stages.whoB: A Bugle reporter who covers his case

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Liz Allan is Mary Jane's friend and confidante. Together they visit Harry Osborn at Ravencroft to tell him Mary Jane is marrying Peter, and Liz is at the wedding when Harry crashes it.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane Watson, her close friend
stages.whoB: Liz Allan, her friend and confidante

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Liz is drawn to Harry Osborn. When Harry, as the Green Goblin, threatens to blow up the church unless Mary Jane marries him, Liz begs him to go back to Ravencroft and admits her feelings for him.
stages.whoA: Harry Osborn, the friend she loves
stages.whoB: Liz Allan, who admits she loves him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Felicia Hardy takes Mrs. Farrell to collect her son Robert from the police station. Later Felicia is the one who tells Robert that his mother has collapsed.
stages.whoA: Felicia Hardy, who helps her and her son
stages.whoB: Robert Farrell's ailing mother

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Peter tutors Mrs. Farrell's son Robert and comes by the store to see him. As Spider-Man, he and Robert fight off the gang that returns to rob her store.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who defends her store
stages.whoB: The mother of Robert, whom he tutors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Flash ridicules Peter at school and is jealous when Felicia picks Peter, so he puts on a fake Spider-Man costume to taunt him and gets carried off by a Spider-Slayer. Spider-Man saves him more than once, and Flash later attends Peter's wedding.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, the classmate he mocks
stages.whoB: Flash Thompson, a classmate who mocks him

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Flash watches the news of Asteroid M falling with Peter and Mary Jane.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, an old classmate
stages.whoB: Flash Thompson, an old classmate

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Felicia dances with Flash at her charity ball, then ditches him for Peter and scolds him for his costume stunt. Later Flash helps Debra, the Black Cat and Dr. Connors identify a mysterious attacker's DNA.
stages.whoA: Felicia Hardy, the girl he dances with
stages.whoB: Flash Thompson, a classmate who courts her

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Flash tries to impress Debra at her new lab and is angry when Peter gets them both thrown out. Later they are attacked together at a jungle exhibit, and both end up in hospital after Miriam drains their plasma.
stages.whoA: Debra Whitman, the girl he tries to impress
stages.whoB: Flash Thompson, who tries to impress her

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spencer Smythe's Spider Seekers spot Flash in his fake Spider-Man costume, and the Black Widow Spider-Slayer carries him off to Oscorp. Smythe's men are about to destroy him when the real Spider-Man arrives.
stages.whoA: Spencer Smythe, whose robot captures him
stages.whoB: A boy his robot mistakes for Spider-Man

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Alistair Smythe blames Flash, among others, for his father's apparent death and sends his Spider-Slayers after him. Spider-Man saves Flash from the Black Widow.
stages.whoA: Alistair Smythe, who hunts him for revenge
stages.whoB: One of the people he blames for his father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Flash finds Debra after the Vulture drains her youth, and the Vulture then tries to take Flash's youth too, until Spider-Man counters him.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, who tries to steal his youth
stages.whoB: A young man whose youth he tries to take

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Stillwell turns Mac Gargan into the Scorpion, and the Scorpion attacks him demanding a cure he says is impossible. Later the Scorpion takes Stillwell from a mental hospital to cure him, and Stillwell destroys his research instead.
stages.whoA: The Scorpion, the man he mutated
stages.whoB: The scientist who mutated him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Jameson has Mac Gargan taken to Stillwell's lab, where Stillwell turns him into the Scorpion to eliminate Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: J. Jonah Jameson, who hires him
stages.whoB: The scientist he hires to make the Scorpion

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Gila is one of the lizards who kidnap Dr. Connors, but she respects humans and refuses to let the others destroy Spider-Man. Branded a traitor, she is locked up beside him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom she refuses to harm
stages.whoB: Gila, a lizard who stands up for him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Gila gains intelligence from Curt Connors's DNA, and she and the other lizards claim him as their father and kidnap him. Connors and the lizards are all turned back to normal in the end.
stages.whoA: Curt Connors, the man she calls father
stages.whoB: A lizard who calls him father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Genevieve works as Herbert Landon's assistant, believing he is curing mutancy, and tells a captive Beast that destroying mutants is the only way to end their suffering. After Landon mutates, he kidnaps her, and she reveals her powers.
stages.whoA: Herbert Landon, her employer
stages.whoB: His assistant, a hidden mutant

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: At the Brand Corporation's press conference, Genevieve uses telekinesis to save Spider-Man from the collapsing roof without revealing herself. Later she saves him and the X-Men again when the mutated Landon drags their jet down.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom she saves twice
stages.whoB: A hidden mutant who saves him twice

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Glory Grant is the secretary at Jameson's Daily Bugle. When the Chameleon slips into the Bugle to steal the security plans for Jameson's conference, he takes her form to escape.
stages.whoA: J. Jonah Jameson, her boss
stages.whoB: Glory Grant, the Bugle's secretary

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Glory works alongside Robbie Robertson at the Daily Bugle. The Chameleon takes the forms of both Robbie and Glory to escape the building with the stolen plans.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, a Bugle colleague
stages.whoB: Glory Grant, the Bugle's secretary

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Gwen tries to kill Spider-Carnage with a sonic gun, but Fisk takes it and Spider-Carnage carries her off as a hostage. He tells her how he means to destroy all reality, and after Uncle Ben reaches him, she sees him leap into an unstable portal.
stages.whoA: Spider-Carnage, who takes her hostage
stages.whoB: Gwen Stacy, the hostage he takes

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man arrives in the world where Gwen is engaged to a rich Peter Parker. She helps him against Spider-Carnage even after learning he is not her fiance, and he frees her once Uncle Ben has reached Spider-Carnage.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, a stranger in her fiance's place
stages.whoB: Gwen Stacy, his double's fiancee
